gideon.line: Visions of Gideon, visions of Gideon
stanza: I have loved you for the last time
Visions of Gideon, visions of Gideon
And I have kissed you for the last time
Visions of Gideon, visions of Gideon

gideon.line: You may talk about the bonds of Gideon
stanza: You may talk about the bonds of Gideon
You may brag about your men of Saul
But you never saw nothing like Joshua
When the sun stopped shining in the middle of the day
The ram horns, the sheep horns began to blow
When the walls came tumbling down
